instrument specifying the seed-syllable used in worship
prescriptive verb enjoining the act of worship
object of worship, identified in context as Dāmodara

items.question: By what means and form should the deity accompanied by Śakti be worshipped?
premises: The prescribed act is worship of the deity.
The worship employs the kāma-seed as its instrument.
The deity is to be worshipped in a six-limbed form together with Śakti.
items.inference: Therefore, one should worship the god together with Śakti in a six-limbed manner using the kāma-seed.
uncertainties: Whether ṣaḍ+aṅgaṃ specifies a six-limb ritual procedure or a six-limbed form of the deity is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: One should worship the god, together with his Śakti, in a six-limbed manner using the kāma-seed.
